title: Neo-Classic: A Benchmark for Evaluating Linguistic-Aesthetic Reasoning in Classical Chinese Poetry

scope.included: 律诗八句重排单元，按完整原序、押韵、对仗和形式合格但原序不符分解结果。
scope.excluded: 不把整套古诗能力题或模型内心过程推断纳入对应。
scope.study_summary: 窄C：诗句排序中分别量化音韵、对仗和整体顺序，检验局部形式约束与整体话语组织的分离；Table5已有正式细分行为结果，不只靠新旧语料准确率差或作者的认知标签。
scope.scope_basis: 冻结交付的最终reason/review及qualification_scope；候选字段仅作定位，事实定向核原文

reading.limits: 逐篇核查已纳入研究单元及其直接支撑方法，引用段落实际读取；未声称全篇全部实验重新阅读或验收。

facts.description: Table5同时报告Perfect Match、Rhyme Great、Parallel Just、Semantic-only Fail及Bad Case Rate，分别给全部回答和排除坏例后的有效回答分母。

evidence.quote:
Table 5: Comprehensive Evaluation of Model Cognition and Performance in Lyu Sorting (Today-Expert).
Accuracy given by Overall/Valid, which considers all cases or excludes bad cases respectively. Rhyme Great means
the output can pass a Lyu metric check, indicating the submitted sort of poem is perfect phonologically. Parallel Just
means the 2 parallel couplets are perfectly recognized (regardless of their relative positions). Semantic-only Fail
means the output is metrically right and the parallel pairs are also correctly recognized, but perfect match is not
reached due to a failure in semantic understanding. Note: GPT-4o is replaced by GPT-5-Pro due to the former’s
near-zero performance.

demands.need: 区分整体还原、局部格律与形式合格但原序不同，明确两种分母。

matches.reason: 论文并列多种输出正确性指标。
以原序不匹配但格律/对仗通过操作化所谓语义失败。
Overall与Valid的纳入分母不同，不可混为同一准确率。
原序不符不自动证明所有语义理解失败。

demands.need: 识别无效排列或格式坏例并将其与内容错误分开记录。

matches.function: 输出格式约束 / 结构化输出
matches.reason: Bad Case率及Valid分母明确区分可用输出与格式/结构无效输出。

limitations: 原论文把原序未还原称语义失败，不能扩大为唯一可能的合理诗序或心理机制结论；未据此判断全套任务。
